attributes.name: ypy-disable
attributes.description: Names the elements that are disabled while the request runs, with the `ypy-disable` extension (included in `ypy.max`). Takes a selector or an extended selector.

attributes.name: ypy-inert
attributes.description: With the `ypy-disable` extension, makes the target of the request `inert` while the request runs. `true` turns it on, `false` turns it off when `config.inert` is on. Off by default.

values.name: true
values.description: The target takes no click, focus or typing until the response arrives.

config.name: inert
config.description: Makes the target of every request `inert` while it runs. `ypy-inert` overrides it per element.
